filename: Gradients, benchmarks, and agents_ a new toolkit for an old uncertainty.pdf
title: Gradients, benchmarks, and agents: a new toolkit for an old uncertainty
parameterization_target: atmospheric physics parameters (radiation, convection, cloud albedo, surface fluxes)
testbed_rationale: Presentation slides overviewing JAX-GCM (JCM), gradient-based calibration, and the ClimateBench v2 benchmarking protocol; no direct dataset downloads or complete code access links are provided in the presentation itself.
pain_points: High computational expense of perturbed parameter ensembles (PPEs) and emulation for coupled Earth system models
Loss landscape ruggedness/local minima in chaotic fluid dynamics when optimizing model parameters over long trajectories
Converting legacy Fortran climate modeling code to modern differentiable frameworks
extraction_notes: The document is a slide deck presented at the CESM Workshop Plenary at NCAR outlining differentiable GCMs (JCM v1/v2), automatic differentiation parameter calibration, the ClimateBench v2 benchmark design, and AI-assisted code migration (Claude Code, ChatGPT).
